items.title: Meta Ads: $35.43 spend, 5 leads, $7.09 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: Yesterday (2026-09-26) Meta spent $35.43 CAD, all on the sole actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 5 leads at $7.09 CPL -- well under the 7-day baseline (2026-09-20 to 2026-09-26: $349.62 / 26 leads, ~$13.45 CPL), so no anomaly. Account is ACTIVE, no ads are flagged, and the other three campaigns (Tiles Carasoul 1.99, Dead Stock Inventory Campaign Campaign, Real Estate List Building) remain PAUSED with no budget delivering.

needs_attention: This branch's ingest/ directory has no meta-ads.json in the 7-day lookback (last local file is 2026-09-08). A cross-branch check (git log --all --diff-filter=A -- '*meta-ads.json') confirms a run completed normally on 2026-09-26 with window 2026-09-19 to 2026-09-25 -- the same branch-isolation artifact already flagged in the 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-26 runs (daily-ingest sessions landing on separate unmerged branches rather than genuinely missed runs). Since coverage already extends through 2026-09-25, today's pull correctly used the standard 1-day window (2026-09-26) rather than widening further.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads -- each valued at 5, matching the counted leads exactly), continuing the pattern flagged on 2026-08-31, 2026-09-02, 2026-09-07, 2026-09-08, and 2026-09-26. No discrepancy in the counted total across any of these runs, but the script's LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set should be extended to cover these rather than continuing to hand-note it every day.
